items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: And if you’re Paul Desmond, you know Paul had it easy.

ctx.x: Well I want to back up and say one thing to your earlier question about Dave and the break-up of the group. Like for me, I wasn’t super on top of it because at that point I was going to Interlochen Arts Academy. So I knew it was going to happen, and it was predicted, but to give you some insights on that I mean I think really what drove that decision was Dave relentlessly being on tour for, you know, twenty years or something. And the next thing that he really wanted to do was devote himself to writing big…
They could drag him on to the next plane to the next gig.
